desks.title: Board pack — quarterly board meeting
desks.description: Chasing twelve papers from eight contributors, assembling the pack for the chair, and running the room, catering and dial-in for meeting day.
desks.brief:
## Board pack — quarterly board meeting

**Executive** Ingrid, CEO · Harbourline Logistics
**Meeting** @+9d, 9:30–15:00, boardroom · 2 directors dialling in
**Papers were due** @-1d · **Chair review** @+2d · **Pack circulates** @+4d

### My job on this one
- Get 12 papers in, on the template, by the cut-off
- Assemble, paginate and index the pack in the board portal
- Room, AV, lunch and the dial-in; flights and hotel for Margit
- Agenda timings agreed with the chair and Ingrid

### Where it stands
Seven of twelve papers are in. Two are drafts waiting on Ingrid's sign-off. The warehouse automation case and the people update are both late after repeated chases, and the risk register refresh hasn't started.

**The chair has agreed: if the risk paper isn't in by @+2d, it moves to the next meeting.**

callout.title: Late: automation case and people update
callout.body: Kwame (2 chases) and Nadia (3 chases) are past the cut-off. Ingrid raises both at leadership @+1d. Anything not in by @+2d goes in the pack as 'to follow' with a one-line reason.

children.label: Test dial-in with both remote directors
Perth director: confirm local start time
Upload and index in the board portal
Print three copies for the chair

blocks.h3: Draft agenda — for the chair's sign-off

blocks.p: Timings agreed with Ingrid. The chair asked for the automation case to get a full hour, so committee reports are compressed to 20 minutes. The items total 330 minutes, which fills 9:30–15:00 exactly — any extra time for one item has to come out of another.

ol: 9:30 Welcome, conflicts, minutes and matters arising (20 min)
10:20 Management accounts, cash and covenants (30 min)
13:15 Next year's budget — first look (45 min)
14:20 Audit and remuneration committee reports (20 min)

blocks.p: The remuneration paper goes to non-executives only and stays out of the main pack. The non-executive session means you're free from 14:40 — I've held **14:45–15:30 for the bank call**.

ul: Does the automation case need the full hour, or 45 minutes plus questions?
Risk register: confirm it moves to the next meeting if it's not in by @+2d

notes.title: Chase log
notes.body:
- @-4d reminder to all contributors, template attached
- @-1d cut-off: seven in
- Kwame: says he's waiting on numbers from Tomás. Checking with Tomás directly before chasing again
- Nadia: survey results only landed @-2d; she's asked for @+1d
- Dev: risk paper not started; chair is fine to defer

Don't chase Ingrid on the CEO report — the draft is in, she just needs 20 minutes to sign it off. Book it.

stickies.title: Today
stickies.body:
1. Ask Tomás about Kwame's numbers
2. Confirm Margit's hotel
3. Lunch numbers to catering
4. Hold 14:45 for the bank call

stickies.title: Ask Ingrid
stickies.body: Sign off the CEO report and the budget draft before chair review @+2d.

stickies.title: Dial-in times
stickies.body: Perth is 2 hours behind, or 3 while NSW is on daylight saving (October to April). A 9:30 start is 7:30 or 6:30 there, so check with the Perth director.

desks.title: Singapore trip — itinerary, briefing and cover
desks.description: Four days in Singapore for a customer review and a partnership meeting: the bookings, the briefing pack, what moves in the calendar and how the inbox is handled while Ingrid is away.
desks.brief:
## Singapore trip — @+12d to @+15d

**Traveller** Ingrid, CEO · **Budget** $8,000 approved · **Costed so far** $7,445, counting the held dinner and the car to Changi · **Left** $555
**Purpose** quarterly review with Straits Cold Chain, and a first partnership meeting with Kallang Freight Partners
**Timing** leaves three days after the board meeting

### What I'm holding
- Flights, hotel, transfers and the dinner for six on day 2
- The briefing pack: who she's meeting, what they want, what we want
- Calendar: nine meetings in the trip week move, get delegated or get declined
- Inbox cover: what I answer, what goes to Tomás, what waits

### Open
The Tuas site visit is held, not confirmed — Straits Cold Chain's ops lead is checking site access. The bank lunch on day 3 isn't booked because Tomás may join. The SG Arrival Card can't be filed until @+10d: Singapore only takes it in the three days before arrival, counting arrival day. The dinner for six is held until I have their dietary list, and the car back to Changi is still to book. **Everything else is booked or confirmed.**

callout.title: Decision needed from Ingrid
callout.body: By @+2d: does Tomás come for the bank lunch on day 3? If yes, I book his flights this week while the fare holds, on his own travel approval. If no, I book lunch for two and brief her on the bank's agenda myself.

rows.item: Dinner with their leadership, table for 6

children.label: Who's in the room on their side?
Roaming on, travel notice on card
Car bookings in the travel app

ul: Transfer to the hotel; evening free
09:00 Straits Cold Chain quarterly review (2 hours)
13:30 Tuas warehouse site visit — to be confirmed
19:00 dinner with their leadership, table for six
10:00 Kallang Freight Partners, partnership meeting (90 min)
12:30 bank relationship lunch — to book once Tomás decides
Afternoon free for calls from the hotel

blocks.p: **Dress** business for days 2 and 3. The site visit needs closed-toe shoes; their team provides hi-vis.

notes.title: Inbox cover while she's away
notes.body:
Rules Ingrid agreed:

- Customers and board: one summary email to her at 18:00 Singapore time, daily
- Finance approvals under $20k: Tomás signs
- Media and speaking requests: hold until she's back
- Recruiters, vendors, newsletters: I reply or archive
- Anything from the chair: forward straight away and message her as well

notes.title: Calendar — what moved
notes.body:
Nine meetings in the trip week:

- Leadership meeting: Tomás chairs
- Three recurring 1:1s: moved to the week after
- Product review: delegated to Kwame
- Two vendor demos: declined, rebook next month
- Town hall: moved to @+18d
- Mentoring call: kept, by phone from the hotel

stickies.body:
1. Ask Ingrid about Tomás and the bank lunch
2. Chase Tuas site access
3. Dietary list for the dinner

stickies.title: Remember
stickies.body: Aisle seat, rows 2–4. No red-eye on the way out.
